name: Ignition WAN v1.0.25 — T2V NSFW (Phr00t)
description: ComfyUI for WAN 2.2 text-to-video NSFW generation with Phr00t Rapid AIO model and RTX 5090 support

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated CivitAI LoRA model version IDs
Comma-separated CivitAI VAE model version IDs
Downloads Phr00t T2V NSFW AIO model (~19.8GB) + umt5 text encoder + VAE. Also supports individual keys or other bundles.
CivitAI API token (optional, for faster downloads)
HuggingFace API token (optional, for private repos)

SageAttention2++ is pre-compiled into the image (sm_120 / RTX 5090). Available immediately on first boot — no background build, no restart needed. In workflow: add KJNodes 'Apply Sage Attention' patch node with sageattn_qk_int8_pv_fp16_cuda backend.
